I've ported the server to Kotlin and it passes all 4 example cases in `node check.mjs`.

It uses only the JDK and the Kotlin standard library, so there are no third-party packages. `build.sh` compiles the sources in `src/main/kotlin/kvhttp/` with `kotlinc` into `build/kvhttp.jar`, and `./app` is a small launcher script that runs it with `java`. Each connection runs on its own lightweight JVM (virtual) thread. Request parsing works the same as the Python version, including the 30-second read limi
